quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.

explanation.bs: „Njima pripadaju bašče ispod kojih teku rijeke – to je veliki uspjeh.“
explanation.en: “Theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.”

quranTranslation.text: Allah promiseth to the believers, men and women, Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide - blessed dwellings in Gardens of Eden. And - greater (far)! - acceptance from Allah. That is the supreme triumph.

explanation.bs: „…a Allahovo zadovoljstvo je veće; to je, zaista, veliki uspjeh.“
explanation.en: “And - greater (far)! - acceptance from Allah. That is the supreme triumph.”

quranTranslation.text: And if a bounty from Allah befell you, he would surely cry, as if there had been no love between you and him: Oh, would that I had been with them, then should I have achieved a great success!

explanation.bs: Licemjer: „Kamo sreće da sam bio s njima, pa da postignem veliki uspjeh!“ – ar-Rāġib: plijen koji oni smatraju uspjehom.
explanation.en: The hypocrite: “Oh, would that I had been with them, then should I have achieved a great success!” — ar-Rāġib: booty they count as triumph.

explanation.bs: „Vjernici su doista uspjeli“ – uspjeh, prije svega ahiretski.
explanation.en: “Successful indeed are the believers” — success, above all that of the Hereafter.

quranTranslation.text: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

explanation.bs: „Uspio je zaista onaj ko je očisti“ – uspjeh kroz čišćenje duše.
explanation.en: “He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow [purifieth it]” — success through purifying the soul.

quranTranslation.text: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.

explanation.bs: Faraonovi čarobnjaci: „Danas će uspjeti onaj ko nadvlada“ – ar-Rāġib: najvjerovatnije dunjalučki uspjeh.
explanation.en: Pharaoh's magicians: “Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful” — ar-Rāġib: most likely worldly success.
